verses.1: May they be destroyed by the power of Ephraim and through deceitfulness. May Israel and Judah be destroyed along with their holy people.
verses.2: Ephraim will spread its influence everywhere; it will be a source of trouble and destruction. It will form an alliance with Assyria, and Egypt will be destroyed.
verses.3: And he will fight against Jehovah with the Jews, and he will harm Jacob according to his ways, just as he has done to others. But Jehovah will restore him.
verses.4: In the wilderness, he followed his brother; and in the valley, he praised God.
verses.5: And he went to the angel and wept. He prayed to him in the house of God, and there he found us. And there, he spoke with us.
verses.6: And the LORD, the God of the armies, shall be remembered.
verses.7: And you, O God, will restore grace and justice. Keep them always, and let them prevail against your enemies.
verses.8: Kanaan in his hands has deceitful ears, to deceive those who love him.
verses.9: And Efrém said, “But I have found refuge. In every place I go, I do not find any danger or harm.”
verses.10: And I, the LORD your God, will bring you out of Egypt. I will rescue you from that land of slavery. I will dwell among you forever.
verses.11: And I spoke about the prophets. I saw many of them, and in the hands of these prophets, there was power.
verses.12: If Gilad and Auch-Shua were in the abyss, they would also be sacrificed as offerings to those who worship them, just like those who worship idols in the fields.
verses.13: And Jacob fled from the land of Aram. He served Israel as a wife did.
verses.14: And through the prophet, Jehovah brought Israel out of Egypt. And through the prophet, Israel was preserved.
verses.15: May Efrayim be punished, and its blood be poured upon it. But its humiliation will be restored to him by his Lord.
